entry.title: MPC Sample Kit Load 1.0.0
entry.summary: # MPC Sample kit load addin 1.0.0 Load Kit on the MPC Sample, bank by bank: put a kit's banks onto the banks you choose and keep the rest of your pads. An addin for MPC OS standalone devices: a library MPC loads at its start (through `LD_PRELOAD`), not a plugin on a track. It is installed to `/data/mpc-addins/sample-kitload/`. ## Requirements - A Gen2 MPC OS standalone device (aarch64: Live III, One G2, Key(s) G2). The installer refuses anything else. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device.
